causal_timestamp_law.C_i(t): close of bar [t-300,t), latest fully completed M5
causal_timestamp_law.features: Inherited exact feature maps are evaluated at the same t; no changing their anchors
causal_timestamp_law.original_availability: Required feature/B records completed and authentic original availability<=t. Acquisition/receipt time is not substituted for historical availability.

shared_laws.cohort: Accepted immutable 1575 study roster in broker-native contexts; no dynamic economic-linkage claim

missingness_law.delayed: unavailable for feature/B if original availability>t
missingness_law.missing: unavailable; no older-hour fallback or forward-fill
missingness_law.no_original_availability_evidence: causal availability UNKNOWN, never PASS by inventing available_at=close_time
missingness_law.tick_volume: reported nonnegative integer where B/feature requires it
